brief.aim: The table holds seven homogeneous, continuous kernel-geometry measurements (area, perimeter, compactness, kernel length/width, asymmetry coefficient, groove length) for 210 seeds with no outcome column, so the evident aim is to segment seed entities into natural morphological groups rather than to predict a labelled target.
brief.repeated_subjects: None observed; each row appears to be a distinct seed with no subject or recording identifier.
